title: test_channel.py:129: Stale comment misrepresents implementation
description: The comment at line 129-130 states 'channel.py uses max(n_channels - 1, 1)' but the actual implementation uses max(n_channels - 1, 2). This documentation drift could mislead developers analyzing the compatibility differences between channel.py and tdma.py. Fix: Update comment to: 'channel.py uses max(n_channels - 1, 2) while tdma.py uses max(num_channels, 3)'
